lines.text: A calculator with two keys: plus one, and double.
lines.caption: A calculator with two keys: plus one, and double.

lines.text: Three to ninety in the FEWEST presses!
lines.caption: Three to ninety in the FEWEST presses!

lines.text: The screen shows three. One key adds one, the other doubles.
lines.caption: The screen shows three. One key adds one, the other doubles.

lines.text: What's the fewest presses to make ninety?
lines.caption: What's the fewest presses to make ninety?

lines.text: Work backwards! Doubling becomes halving, and plus one becomes minus one.
lines.caption: Work backwards! Doubling becomes halving, and plus one becomes minus one.

lines.text: Halve when you can. If it's odd, take one away first.
lines.caption: Halve when you can. If it's odd, take one away first.

lines.text: Forty-five, forty-four, twenty-two, eleven, ten, five, four, three!
lines.caption: Forty-five, forty-four, twenty-two, eleven, ten, five, four, three!

lines.text: Count the arrows, not the numbers. Eight presses!
lines.caption: Count the arrows, not the numbers. Eight presses!

lines.text: Count the numbers instead, and you'd say nine.
lines.caption: Count the numbers instead, and you'd say nine.

lines.text: Can anything beat eight? The full lesson proves it, and shows every trap.
